title: Database timeout
content: Check the connection pool and active database connections.

title: Cache eviction
content: Review cache capacity and eviction rate.

title: Message consumer lag
content: Check consumer throughput, partition assignment, and failed message processing before increasing consumer capacity.

title: Disk pressure
content: Check filesystem usage, log growth, temporary files, and database volume capacity before removing data.

title: HTTP 5xx errors
content: Check upstream health, gateway error logs, recent deployments, and dependency response times before changing traffic or retry settings.

title: Container out of memory
content: Check container memory usage, configured resource limits, restart count, and workload growth before increasing a memory limit.

title: CI pipeline failure
content: Inspect the failed job logs, the first failing step, recent dependency changes, and the affected build environment before retrying the pipeline.
